messages.content: Rewrite this one-day trip request the way a real traveller might type it: change the wording and the sentence order, informal is fine. Keep EVERY number, time (exactly as written, 24-hour HH:MM), money amount and place name exactly as written. Do not add, drop or change any requirement. Output only the rewritten request.

I have 4 hours and 30 minutes starting at 09:00. I can spend at most S$32. I definitely need to see Maxwell Food Centre and Merlion Park. Optionally, Chinatown Complex Food Centre, ArtScience Museum, Singapore Cable Car, Tekka Centre, Universal Studios Singapore, Jewel Changi Airport Rain Vortex, Singapore Oceanarium, Singapore Botanic Gardens and National Orchid Garden. I'd like to spend 30 minutes at Jewel Changi Airport Rain Vortex. I'd like to spend 90 minutes at Singapore Botanic Gardens.
